title: The sagging is ridiculous.
text: The sagging is ridiculous.. I do not understand where one gets to call an item a clothesline when I use it and it promptly pulls all the clothes to the ground. It stretches out like a rubber band. A clothesline, a real clothesline of cotton is thicker and gives little when clothes are hung on it. I hung out a line of everyday cotton clothes from the washer and ended up with them hanging down in the dirt and grass. So very disappointed. Shame that some of us even in this modern age like to smell air dried clothes and save on power and cannot find a decent clothesline.
